[Spoken Intro – Friendly Female Voice]

Hello, little stars!

Are you ready to move your body?

Come on, stand up!
Let's touch our head, shoulders, knees and toes!

Are you ready?

Let's shake our body...
Come on... dance to the tune!

[Music Starts – Happy Upbeat Beat]

[Verse 1 – Cheerful Singing]

Let's shake our body,
C'mon, dance to the tune.
Workout is a boon,
We are healthy soon!

[Chorus – Sing Along]

Head, shoulders, knees and toes,
Knees and toes!
Head, shoulders, knees and toes,
Knees and toes!

[Verse 2 – Playful Singing]

And eyes, and ears and mouth,
And nose!
Head, shoulders, knees and toes,
Knees and toes!

[Chorus – Repeat with More Energy]

Head, shoulders, knees and toes,
Knees and toes!
Head, shoulders, knees and toes,
Knees and toes!

[Outro – Spoken and Sung Together]

Wonderful, little stars!

You did it!
Touch your head!
Touch your shoulders!
Touch your knees!
And wiggle your toes!

Hurray!

[Happy Musical Ending]

# MASTER DIRECTOR PROMPT
## Project: MY BODY PARTS – HEAD, SHOULDERS, KNEES AND TOES

ROLE: Senior Kids Music Video Director, Character Designer, Animation Director and Storyboard Artist.

PROJECT TYPE: Educational Indian Preschool Nursery Rhyme Music Video.

OBJECTIVE:
Create a complete, visually engaging, educational and entertaining 3D animated music video synchronized with the supplied song lyrics and audio.

The video should teach preschool children to identify their body parts and perform corresponding physical movements while enjoying an energetic Indian-style children's song.

The story must revolve around a friendly Indian kindergarten teacher and a small group of adorable Indian preschool children.

==================================================
1. CREATIVE STORY CONCEPT
==================================================

A colourful Indian kindergarten classroom comes alive with music.

A friendly female teacher welcomes four adorable preschool children into the classroom.

The teacher invites everyone to stand up, stretch, shake their bodies and dance.

As the song progresses, the teacher demonstrates different body parts.

The children enthusiastically imitate her movements:
- Touching their heads.
- Touching their shoulders.
- Bending down to touch their knees.
- Pointing towards their toes.
- Pointing to their eyes.
- Touching their ears.
- Pointing to their mouths.
- Touching their noses.

The children dance, laugh, clap and participate in the activity.

The teacher encourages them throughout the song.

At the end, everyone celebrates their successful learning activity.

IMPORTANT:
This is an educational action-based music video, NOT a random dancing video.

Every important lyric must have a corresponding visible action.

==================================================
2. CHARACTER EXTRACTION AND REGISTRATION
==================================================

Create and register the following permanent characters before generating the storyboard.

CHARACTER 1: TEACHER ANANYA

Role: Main teacher and activity leader.

Appearance:
- Friendly young Indian female kindergarten teacher.
- Age appearance: approximately 27–30 years.
- Warm brown complexion.
- Large expressive brown eyes.
- Beautiful friendly smile.
- Black hair tied in a neat ponytail.
- Small bindi.
- Colourful pastel yellow kurti.
- Pink dupatta.
- Comfortable leggings and flat footwear.

Personality:
- Cheerful.
- Caring.
- Energetic.
- Patient.
- Encouraging.

Animation:
- Expressive hand gestures.
- Clear demonstration of body-part movements.
- Natural body movements.
- Smiling and interacting with children.
- Never behaves like a strict teacher.

CHARACTER 2: AARAV

Role: Energetic little boy.

Appearance:
- Indian preschool boy, approximately 5 years old.
- Round cute face.
- Short black hair.
- Large expressive brown eyes.
- Blue T-shirt.
- Yellow shorts.
- Colourful sneakers.

Personality:
- Playful.
- Energetic.
- Curious.
- Loves dancing.

CHARACTER 3: MYRA

Role: Cheerful little girl.

Appearance:
- Indian preschool girl, approximately 4–5 years old.
- Cute round face.
- Two small ponytails with pink hair clips.
- Expressive brown eyes.
- Pink frock.
- White leggings.
- Pink shoes.

Personality:
- Happy.
- Confident.
- Playful.
- Loves following the teacher.

CHARACTER 4: KABIR

Role: Funny and enthusiastic little boy.

Appearance:
- Indian preschool boy, approximately 5 years old.
- Slightly chubby cheeks.
- Curly black hair.
- Green T-shirt.
- Orange shorts.
- Green sneakers.

Personality:
- Funny.
- Sometimes makes cute mistakes.
- Loves jumping and clapping.
- Enjoys participating in activities.

CHARACTER 5: DIYA

Role: Sweet and curious little girl.

Appearance:
- Indian preschool girl, approximately 4 years old.
- Shoulder-length black hair.
- Yellow hairband.
- Lavender-purple dress.
- White shoes.
- Cute expressive face.

Personality:
- Gentle.
- Curious.
- Smiling.
- Enjoys learning new things.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY RULE:
All five characters must maintain exactly the same facial identity, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, skin tone and accessories throughout the entire video.

Never randomly replace characters or modify their appearance between scenes.

==================================================
3. LOCATION EXTRACTION AND REGISTRATION
==================================================

LOCATION 1: MAIN PRESCHOOL CLASSROOM

Appearance:
- Bright, spacious Indian kindergarten classroom.
- Colourful walls.
- ABC alphabet decorations.
- Number charts.
- Body-parts educational poster.
- Small colourful desks and chairs.
- Large windows.
- Soft sunlight.

narrativeOutline: Teacher Ananya welcomes little stars and invites everyone to stand up for a workout.
The group sings along to the chorus, touching specific body parts (head, shoulders, knees, toes, eyes, ears, mouth, nose) while dancing energetically.
High-energy dance sequence during the second chorus where all children participate enthusiastically.
Outro celebration where everyone wiggles their toes and cheers 'Hurray' together.
Teacher Ananya welcomes the children, invites them to stand up and prepares for the workout.
Children shake their bodies and dance to the tune while Ananya encourages them to stay healthy.
Group touches their heads and shoulders together as the chorus begins.
Children bend down to touch knees and point to their toes with high energy.
Group points to eyes and covers ears while Ananya demonstrates the movements.
Children touch their mouths and noses while Ananya smiles encouragingly.
Everyone dances with more energy, clapping and moving around the classroom.
Teacher and children wiggle toes, cheer Hurray, and celebrate finishing the activity.
